project_comments.note: Path-traversal hardening gap: WP-003 correctly secured the slug parameter across all 5 GUI handlers. However, the wpId parameter passed to handleGetWorkPackage() is forwarded to wpDetailPath() as join(storageDir, `${wpId}.json`) without validation. A malicious wpId (e.g., '../../../target') could in theory escape the storage directory. The existing Zod schema parse provides a secondary protection layer (an escaped JSON file would likely fail schema validation), but an explicit assertSafeWpId() guard (similar in pattern to assertSafeSlug) would close this completely. Recommended as a follow-on task scoped to the GUI API layer.
